page_title: TOU 4-0 MET | Toulouse v Metz 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Toulouse are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Great teamplay by Toulouse as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
84' 4 - 0 Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 4:0.
84' Toulouse get a corner.
84' A substitution has been made. Habib Diallo is replaced by Joel Asoro (Metz).
83' Stephane Le Mignan decides to make a substitution. Gauthier Hein will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julian Vignolo (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Yann Gboho cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Poor challenge! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is penalised for tripping and Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Metz have a free kick.
79' 3 - 0 Goal! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 3:0.
76' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Dayann Methalie is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) replaces Emersonn.
74' Caution goes to Emersonn (Toulouse).
74' Referee Francois Letexier sees the trip by Emersonn (Toulouse) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Metz.
71' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to make a change. Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) replaces Fode Ballo-Toure.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Boubacar Traore departs the field of play to be replaced by Jessy Deminguet (Metz).
69' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
68' Metz work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
66' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' Here is a change. Djibril Sidibe is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
64' Frank Magri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mark McKenzie (Toulouse).
62' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
61' Francois Letexier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alpha Toure (Metz). Toulouse have a free kick.
59' Emersonn (Toulouse) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
58' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
55' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
53' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
49' Toulouse enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Giorgi Abuashvili as he is replaced by Terry Yegbe (Metz).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' You can see a deep sadness in the eyes of Sadibou Sane (Metz) as he leaves the pitch after receiving a red card.
45+2' Sadibou Sane (Metz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse will take a free kick near the side line.
45+1' Boubacar Traore (Metz) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Toulouse.
41' Guillaume Restes is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz). Easy save! The ball is out of play. Metz will have a throw-in.
38' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Aron Donnum (Toulouse), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
37' Frank Magri (Toulouse) earns the yellow card.
37' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Francois Letexier signals a set piece. Metz earn a free kick.

35' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Jonathan Fischer pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
34' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) gets a yellow card.
34' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
34' Emersonn (Toulouse) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
32' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Metz.
30' Francois Letexier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Koffi Kouao (Metz).
28' Gauthier Hein (Metz) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
26' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) brought his opponent down. Metz will take a free kick.
21' Alpha Toure (Metz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
18' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) works the corner short.

18' He should have scored! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out for a corner. Toulouse can continue in their attacking effort.
16' A raking crossfield pass from Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
14' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
8' 2 - 0 Goal! Jonathan Fischer gets a hand on the penalty from Aron Donnum (Toulouse), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
7' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is going to take the penalty!

6' Boubacar Traore (Metz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francois Letexier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee gives a penalty to Toulouse!

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Jonathan Fischer had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.

Toulouse will kick the game off.
